page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For storage, the instance is equipped with 1919 GB of bundled local SSD storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate average multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 11753.77 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 5851.0. However, single-core capabilities are relatively weak, as shown by a Geekbench single-core score of 937.0 and a poor single-threaded gzip compression rate of 18.95 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth remains in the average tier, measuring 72.03 GB/sec for large-block read operations and 51.45 GB/sec for large-block write operations. Database operations on Passmark score at 4302.63, while Redis SET operations achieve an average throughput of 11.71 million operations per second.

The primary tradeoff of this instance lies in its single-threaded processing limitations, making it less suitable for single-core intensive tasks. However, the presence of dedicated physical cores and a substantial 1919 GB local SSD storage bundle makes it a resource-dense option for multi-threaded workloads. This hardware profile is well-suited for database operations, static web serving, and general-purpose applications that require local high-capacity SSD storage without the need for GPU acceleration.
